name: mounting_hole_m25
title: Mounting holes
purpose: One M2.5 mounting hole (not plated), the same size as the Raspberry Pi boards' and the star-tracker HAT's

sources.title: Raspberry Pi uHAT board mechanical drawing
sources.read: holes 3.5 mm from edges, 2.75 mm drill, 6.2 mm land

parts.quote: "MOUNTING HOLES SHOULD BE DRILLED TO 2.75mm +/- 0.05mm" (2.7 mm is the drawing's lower limit); "MOUNTING HOLE LAND SHOULD BE MIN. 6.2mm". The Pi's hole size reused here; the hole positions are this board's own (3.5 mm from each edge, as the Pi's)

layout.rules: keep 6.2 mm round the hole clear (the screw head's land)

open_questions: Hole positions are not matched to a housing yet (none designed).
